input.description: the input tensor representing a half-Hermitian signal

n.description: Output signal length. This determines the length of the real output. If given, the input will either be zero-padded or trimmed to this length before computing the Hermitian FFT. Defaults to even output: ``n=2*(input.size(dim) - 1)``.
constraints: n must be one of FFT

dim.description: The dimension along which to take the one dimensional Hermitian FFT.

norm.description: Normalization mode. For the forward transform (:func:`~torch.fft.hfft`), these correspond to:
